description: This file defines the LoggerManager class, which manages logging functionalities including log levels, loggers, and logging methods. It provides mechanisms for configuring and invoking different types of loggers, handling log levels and mappings, and ensures encapsulation of logger instances within a PHP application.

classes.name: LoggerManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages logging levels, loggers, and provides a unified interface to log messages at various levels.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles logging requests dynamically based on method name and message.

methods.name: wouldLog
methods.description: Checks if a message at a certain log level would produce output given the current configuration.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Performs a condition check and logs a debug message if the condition fails.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LoggerManager.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a specific logger class to a log level.

methods.name: _findAvailableLoggers
methods.description: Discovers and loads available logger classes from predefined directories.

methods.name: getAvailableLoggers
methods.description: Returns the list of available logger class names.

methods.name: getLoggerLevels
methods.description: Returns the mapping of log levels with formatted names.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the application's current log level.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level setting.

methods.name: setLevelMapping
methods.description: Configures the numeric mapping for a specific log level.
